Let's check the required topics:
- an ordinary working day, from start to end (asked)
- the worst day of the last few months, and what made it bad (asked)
- what they check by hand today because they do not trust it
- what they are afraid a new service would do wrong
- what they need to know right after something has gone wrong
- who they hand work to, and who hands work to them (asked)

Let's ask what they check by hand before signing off a flight.
[/-Thinking-]What do you currently check by hand before you sign off a flight because you don't trust it to be right otherwise?
